name: Dragon
description: A dragon is a monstrous foe famous for it's large wingspan and fire breath capable of incinerating their enemies. Even without their lost draconic magic, dragons are clever creatures known for building formidable lairs where they hoard treasures beyond counting.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: The dragon makes an attack with it's razor-sharp claws, dealing physical damage. If a creature takes more than 10 damage after mitigation from this attack, they gain the bleeding condition.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: The dragon bites a creature, dealing physical damage. The target must make a resilience check against half the damage taken after mitigation or gain 1 tier of the wounded condition.

actions.name: Fire Breath
actions.description: The dragon unleashes flames in an 8 unit cone, dealing fire damage to all creatures inside. All creatures who take fire damage after mitigations gain the ignited condition. A creature who reaches 0 health from this ability must make a resilience check of 9 or higher or be turned to ash. When the dragon uses this action, it must make a resilience check of 8 or higher; failure results in gaining 1 tier of the Exhausted condition. The target number increases by 1 with each use and resets after a full rest. If the dragon becomes Exhausted in this way, it cannot use this ability again until the condition is removed. This attack can be used once per round.

actions.name: Tail Sweep
actions.description: After using either the Bite Action, the dragon sweeps their tail in a 3 unit cone that does not include the target of the Bite action, striking all creatures for physical damage. On a true hit, large and smaller creatures are also knocked prone.

actions.name: Violent Ascent
actions.description: The dragon uses it's wings to propel itself 6 units into the air, causing all creatures below within a 4 unit radius to be buffeted by wind knocking them prone.

actions.name: Impact Landing
actions.description: In response to falling, the dragon can change the point of it's landing by up to 3 units horizontally as long as no huge or larger creatures would overlap the end position, dealing damage in a 4 unit radius from the center point from where it lands. All creatures within the 4 unit radius are displaced to a point adjacent to the area, take physical damage and are knocked prone.

actions.name: Evasion Pattern
actions.description: In response to being targeted by a projectile attack while flying, the dragon attempts to present the hardest part of it's scaled armor towards the attack, gaining a 2d4 bonus to their next 3 block checks against projectiles before the start of their turn.

actions.name: Multiclaw
actions.description: After making an attack with their Claw Action, the dragon makes an attack with their other claw against the same target, dealing physical damage.

actions.name: Dragon Wings
actions.description: While not on the ground, the dragon flies up to 4 units, fulfilling the requirements for Active Flight.

traits.name: Active Flight
traits.description: The dragon must spend at least 1 action per round to maintain their height while flying, otherwise, they immediately fall at the end of their turn.

traits.name: Ancient Mind
traits.description: Dragons are immune to effects that alter their state of mind such as confusion, maddened and the charmed condition. Additionally, they are immutable.
